newsitem.title: UK: Guinness,GrandMet to respond to LVMH today.
newsitem.headline: Guinness,GrandMet to respond to LVMH today.

text.p: Britain's Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc will make an initial joint response to a proposal from their biggest shareholder French luxury goods company LVMH on Wednesday afternoon, said a spokesman acting for both companies.
"GMG Brands will make an initial response later this afternoon," said the spokesman. GMG Brands is the name given to the proposed 24 billion stg merger of Guinness and GrandMet.

The companies received an 18 page fax from Bernard Arnault, chairman of LVMH earlier on Wednesday and need time to consult with their lawyers, and advisers Cazenove and Lazards before drafting a response.

LVMH announced a plan for merging its drinks business with Guinness and GrandMet. Arnault suggested a merger of LVMH's Moet Hennessy cognac and champagne business with United Distillers of Guinness and International Distiller and Vitners of Grand Met to create a group with sales of 7.4 billion stg for the year 1995/1996.
